fields.value: Additional file 8: of Surface PEGylation suppresses pulmonary effects of CuO in allergen-induced lung inflammation

dsDescriptionValue.value: Figure S4. Dialysis curves showing the release of total dissolved copper from uncoated CuO NPs core, CuO-COOH, CuO-NH4+ and CuO-PEG NPs over a 24 h period when suspended in (A) Ultrapure Milli-Q water, or (B) Krebs physiological saline. Controls are the respective water or saline without nanomaterials. Data are means ± S.D., n = 3 replicates. Curves were fitted using SigmaPlot 13.0 (Systat Software, Inc.) applying the single rectangular two parameter hyperbola equation on the raw data. From Besinis and Handy, unpublished. (TIF 672 kb)
